stable.headline: A polish of the interface, and a tidier folder
notes: A polish of the interface: icons, menus and dropdowns now look and open alike.
The folder is tidier: the program is in one folder, app, and an older install needs the full download once.
A new launcher window draws the name out of a wire mesh.
Export keeps the common options up front and the rest under Advanced, with new Pivot points for FBX, GLB and USDZ.
Lock a whole group; the right-click menus of the part tree are shorter.
Fixes: right-click menu flicker, tooltips over open menus, the + and - in the tree.
